stations.title: Rhona
stations.note: The council wants it this week.

stations.title: Dougie's tries
stations.text: Each try changes the last function named.

stations.title: Your mends
stations.gap: A mistake far from the error

captions: At the base, Rhona asks why the hill report for the council keeps stopping.
Dougie changed the last function in each error, and the report still stops.
You read each traceback from the bottom up and mend the one function with the mistake.
Now each part of the report prints, and nothing that worked was changed.
The report reaches the council, and each mistake was mended where it was made.
